title: Platinum End
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Orphan Mirai Kakehashi, abused by the relatives who killed his parents, tries to end his life and is saved by the angel Nasse, who gives him wings and arrows that kill or cause infatuation. He learns he is one of thirteen candidates to replace a retiring God, and allies with those who refuse to kill against Metropoliman, who murders rivals. From the creators of Death Note; Viz publishes it; rating to verify.
life_message: It searches for what happiness is and whether killing for a cause can ever be justified.

content.note: Murders of candidates, a child killed as hostage, firearms and abductions (Wikipedia; AniList Crime and Survival tags).
Death-game stakes across 999 days (Wikipedia; Survival and Tragedy signals).

ANN's vol. 1 review describes a god candidate (a comedian) sexually assaulting a group of young idols, an angel 'basically naked at all times' and 'a whole lot' of fan service; love arrows 'bind someone's love against their will', and Wikipedia says one candidate uses them to make women join a polyamorous relationship with him.
content.frequency: Fan service recurring; one assault scene in vol. 1

content.note: Opens with a suicide attempt; several more attempts and a family's assisted deaths (Wikipedia; AniList Suicide tag).
Suicide methods depicted; mind control over others (Wikipedia; AniList Suicide tag).
